Title: Original Tamagotchi Winter Red | Product Information | BANDAI TOYS
# BANDAI TOYS. ## Product Details. Release Date：2026/11/21. Target Age：6years and older. The " Original Tamagotchi Winter Red" has been released as part of the " Original Tamagotchi " series, which includes the European and American versions of the original "Tamagotchi," "New Species Discovered!! tamagotchi ," and "Tenshitchi's tamagotchi "! Find the design that best reflects your personality! This Original Tamagotchi features a cute, warm design inspired by winter cocoa. It features the GEN1 program, which allows you to raise Mametchi and other characters. Besides taking care of them by feeding them, flushing their poop, and treating their illnesses, you can also train them and play mini-games with them! Depending on how you raise it, it will grow into various tamagotchi. It can be attached to clothing or bags using the ball chain, allowing you to carry it around as a fashion item. \*This product's program includes some English text. \* BANDAI does not sell screen protectors for LCD screens. \*The Images are for illustrative purposes only. \*The included batteries are for testing purposes only. (This product does not come with any products other than the set contents.).

sources.title: Tamagotchi Is Officially Making a Comeback - Business Insider
sources.snippet:
It's official — 20 years after it first made waves on the playground, Japanese toy maker Bandai is bringing back the Tamagotchi.

Bandai just re-released the popular 90s virtual pet in its six original colours, causing an outpouring of nostalgia via Twitter.

The toy is currently available to buy in stores in Japan, or online via Amazon Japan for 1,900 yen (£14 or $17). [...] According to Mashable, while Bandai has stayed true to the original aesthetic, the new edition of the handheld eggs are about half the size of the original version.

Since the toys' arrival in 1996, over 76 million of the cult-like digital pets are thought to have been sold worldwide.
